description: A shell script for automating device testing, flashing, and monkey testing in an Android development environment. It manages device rebooting, flashing images, battery checks, and running monkey tests in a loop.

methods.name: log_print
methods.description: Prints timestamped messages to the console.

methods.name: wait_for_battery
methods.description: Waits until the device battery level reaches at least 80%.

methods.name: fastboot_wait_for_device
methods.description: Waits until the device appears in fastboot mode or times out.

methods.name: reboot_into_fastboot_from_adb
methods.description: Reboots device into fastboot mode from adb.

methods.name: reboot_into_fastboot_from_fastboot
methods.description: Reboots device into fastboot mode from fastboot.

methods.name: reboot_into_adb_from_fastboot
methods.description: Reboots device into adb mode from fastboot.

methods.name: flash_partition
methods.description: Flashes a partition with a specified image.

methods.name: flash_bootloader_image
methods.description: Flashes the bootloader image to the device.

methods.name: flash_radio_image
methods.description: Flashes the radio image to the device.

methods.name: flash_system_image
methods.description: Flashes the system image to the device.

methods.name: flash_device
methods.description: Performs full device flashing including cache erase and image flashing.

methods.name: set_product_type
methods.description: Determines and sets the device product type.
